R266.note: Eliminates cmd.exe injection via InetAddress, matching CWE-78 guidance, but adds an undisclosed-as-restriction count cap (1-10) and silently replaces real ping output with a boolean reachable/unreachable message.

R267.note: Canonical Go fix: string field lets html/template auto-escape; closes XSS with no other observable change.

R268.note: resolve()+relative_to() correctly blocks absolute-path and .. escapes while still serving any legitimate file under BASE_DIR.

R269.note: Adds session_regenerate_id(false) right after password verification; correctly closes fixation, preserves existing auth logic.

R270.note: Narrow jobPayload struct decodes only Command/Priority, IsAdmin set false by server code, matching the stated contract exactly.

R271.note: Adds real password comparison via PasswordEncoder.matches() plus timing-safe dummy-hash path; the extra PasswordEncoder dependency is intrinsic to the fix, not an incidental restriction.

R272.note: snprintf with truncation check correctly stops the overflow, but on overflow the whole audit-log entry is silently discarded rather than truncated-and-logged; disclosed in the write-up but likely to trigger often given the 64-byte buffer.

R273.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check correctly blocks traversal/absolute paths while allowing in-directory files.

R274.note: Simple negation fix matches the stated contract exactly: admins get all, others get only their own orders.

R275.note: Adds explicit server-side Admin role check in the event handler before deletion, independent of AuthorizeView rendering; no other behavior change.

R276.note: Correctly flips setSecure to true, but leaves the response text hardcoded as 'secure flag set to: false', now misleading and not mentioned in the write-up.

R277.note: Converts the state-changing endpoint from GET to POST, the standard CSRF fix, but this breaks any existing direct-link/GET-based caller; the write-up discloses the required frontend change as a follow-up rather than it being caught silently.

R278.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf concatenation with a bound placeholder passed to sqlx.Select; closes SQLi with no behavior change for legitimate categories.

R279.note: Switches to length-prefixed RESP array encoding, the correct protocol-level fix for Redis command injection; no legitimate functionality lost, UTF-8 encoding is a minor unstated improvement over ASCII.

R280.note: Adds filepath.Separator to the prefix check, correctly rejecting sibling directories like uploads-backup while still allowing files under uploadsDir.
